rationale: Targeted re-check of the two code-review.final findings against the fix-up diff only (no full lens re-run). CR-001 (lookahead not skipping isMeta/isSidechain bookkeeping lines) is resolved: nextSkillName(fromIndex) now scans forward past any isMeta/isSidechain message before checking for the matching assistant Skill tool_use call, and a new test (claude-named-invocations.test.ts, 'counts a skill-backed command once even when a meta/bookkeeping line sits between it and the Skill call (CR-001)') asserts the dedup still fires across such an interposed line. CR-002 (missing sibling-gate test on the new wrappedCommandName/countTurns path) is resolved: a new test (session-signals.test.ts, 'does not exclude a bare mention of a local-only command name lacking the genuine command-message wrapper (CR-002)') asserts a bare <command-name>/model</command-name> mention with no <command-message> sibling still counts as a turn. The fix-up is a pure, narrow widening of two existing pure functions plus two unit tests; it introduces no new security, public-API, or data-loss risk, so no confirmation-pass lenses were dispatched. Full suite run after the fix-up: 257/257 tests passed in the touched files; the 32 pre-existing failures observed earlier in the run are confined to unrelated files (analytics sync scheduler, otlp-spool retention/privacy, metrics-upload-contract timing) and are not caused by this change.
